theme: 指数·境内指数行情与多指数对比：深证成指行情点位、年内涨幅、上证50同日对比与中证1000估值切换

initial.question: 深证成指最近一个交易日的收盘点位是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106000028 AND ISVALID=1 ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 它今年以来累计上涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((a.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS ytd_pct FROM INDX_MKT a JOIN INDX_MKT b ON b.INNER_CODE=a.INNER_CODE AND b.ISVALID=1 WHERE a.INNER_CODE=106000028 AND a.ISVALID=1 AND a.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106000028 AND ISVALID=1) AND b.TRADEDATE='2025-12-31'

feedbacks.question: 上证50在同一个交易日收在多少点？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106000255 AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106000028 AND ISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 那2025年全年它涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((a.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS ret_2025 FROM INDX_MKT a JOIN INDX_MKT b ON b.INNER_CODE=a.INNER_CODE AND b.ISVALID=1 WHERE a.INNER_CODE=106000028 AND a.ISVALID=1 AND a.TRADEDATE='2025-12-31' AND b.TRADEDATE='2024-12-31'

feedbacks.question: 这些点位是交易所发布的官方收盘行情吗，还是复权价？
帮我看看中证1000指数最新一个交易日的市盈率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT PE FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE INNER_CODE=106006433 AND ISVALID=1 ORDER BY TRD_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
